Concord City Treasurer (Edith Patricia "Patti" Barsotti only), San Pablo City Clerk (Dorothy Gantt only) and Treasurer (Viviana Toledo only), Pittsburg City Treasurer (Nancy Parent only qualified): uncontested; whether appointed in lieu or on ballot not verified.
San Ramon Valley Fire Protection District (2 seats): Ryan Crean and Bill Clarkson qualified; Jason Alan Skeoch listed without (q). Danville San Ramon suggests uncontested. Unverified.

Kensington Community Services District: full term (Rodney Kenneth Paul, Daniel Levine, Adam Bastein) and short term (Paul, Bastein, Alexandra Aquino-Fike) listings are inconsistent with guide's 3-seat count; could not determine what is on ballot.

Mt. Diablo USD Area 1: James Walsh pulled papers but not shown qualified; listed as presumed uncontested.
